sources.content: # Quillmoss agent notes. Quillmoss is a command line tool that indexes local Markdown notes into a searchable SQLite file. The project uses Rust 1.79 with Cargo workspaces. Run `cargo build` at the workspace root to build every crate, and run the test suite with `cargo test`. The integration tests in `crates/qm-index/tests` need the `QM_FIXTURES` environment variable pointing to the `fixtures/` directory. Never edit files under `fixtures/golden/` by hand; regenerate them with `cargo run -p qm-tools regen-golden`.

Conventions. All public functions carry a doc comment that starts with a verb. Error types live in `crates/qm-core/src/error.rs` and use the thiserror crate; library code does not return boxed errors. Log through the tracing crate at debug level or lower inside loops. Commit messages follow the pattern `area: summary` with a lowercase area such as `index` or `cli`. Pull requests must stay under 400 changed lines unless a maintainer approves a larger one in the issue first. Format with `cargo fmt` before every commit.

claims.text: Quillmoss stores its search index in a SQLite file.
Quillmoss error types use the thiserror crate.
The Quillmoss integration tests require the QM_FIXTURES environment variable.
Quillmoss pull requests may contain up to 500 changed lines without maintainer approval.
Quillmoss supports exporting notes to HTML.
Quillmoss commit messages use the pattern area: summary.
